document_h1: Access to this section is restricted
text: Personal access Returning customers only Access to this section is restricted This is a necessary measure: the section is kept only for people who have already bought software from IVSOFTE. Sign in with the e-mail you used for your purchase, or with a password from the administrator. You are signed in Access is active on this device. Open the section Access granted Opening the section… Open the section Purchase e-mail Password Access stays active on this device for 30 days. How to get access 1 Enter the e-mail you used for a purchase. If it is on the list, access opens immediately. 2 Address not accepted? Message the administrator and confirm a purchase: an order number, or the e-mail and an approximate date. 3 The administrator will issue a password — enter it on the “Password” tab. Never send your mailbox password, bank card details or other payment credentials.
